description: Tracks the player's investigative activity, discoveries, and active detection in the current area. Scoped to the current location — reset when the player moves to a new area.

fields.searched_areas: array of strings — parts of the current location that have been searched or examined (e.g. 'north wall', 'the desk', 'behind the waterfall')
fields.discovered_items: array of objects — items found during exploration: { name, description, location_found }
fields.discovered_secrets: array of strings — hidden information, concealed doors, or secrets uncovered
fields.knowledge_checks_attempted: array of objects — knowledge rolls made: { topic, result (success|failure), what_learned }
fields.active_detection: string or null — any ongoing detection effect active (e.g. 'Detect Magic running', 'Tracking footprints', 'Listen check in progress')
fields.pending_investigations: array of strings — things the player has flagged to investigate but has not yet examined

notes: This context is scoped to the current area. When the player leaves, preserve discovered_items and discovered_secrets but clear searched_areas and active_detection.
Do not populate this context for purely social or traversal actions — only when the player is actively investigating, searching, or using knowledge skills.
A successful Perception check that reveals something should populate discovered_secrets.
